phone.notes: Forms you already unlocked now show on the farm instead of "???", a crash when opening a Digimon is fixed, and the bracelet reports are more detailed so we can find why some phones fail. If something breaks or feels unfair, tell us in #bug-reports. Requires Android 13 or newer.

watch.notes: The watch face can show the data you choose (date, heart rate, battery...) and has a new plate. The steps past the daily limit of the tamer now give coins (from the server). If something breaks or feels unfair, tell us in #bug-reports.
